connector.name: Silicon Analysts
connector.registryDescription: Dated, sourced semiconductor data: chip costs, HBM/wafer pricing, fab capacity, policy, forecasts.
connector.summary: Hosted at siliconanalysts.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the siliconanalysts account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OPTIONAL Bearer token. Anonymous access works with no credential (all 19 tools, full data fidelity for current values, ~20 requests / 24h per IP). A free API key raises the limit to 100 / 24h, attributes usage, and unlocks a preview of historical time series: https://siliconanalysts.com/developers — format 'Bearer sa_live_xxx'. OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) also supported for Claude.ai Custom Connectors.
